name: Krzemionki Prehistoric Striped Flint Mining Region
description: In Poland's Świętokrzyskie region, near Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski, Krzemionki is a network of Stone Age and Bronze Age flint mines worked from about 3900 to 1600 BCE. Miners dug some 4,000 shafts and pits to reach banded flint, which they shaped into axes traded up to 500 km away. Visitors can walk through preserved underground galleries and see the old workshop areas.
